overview_description.description: PrimeVault is a deep-tech crypto infrastructure company that is dedicated to building innovative core tools that make on-chain participation and DeFi access convenient, efficient and secure for businesses and institutions of any size and scale. PrimeVault meshes cutting-edge cryptography (MPC and HE) with privacy-preserving Smart Contracts to offer powerful on-chain automations, programmable cross-chain wallets, comprehensive portfolio tracker, seamless CeDeFi interoperability with both on- and off-chain markets, and sophisticated risk mitigation solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: Next gen security, execution and risk management platform for institutional CeDeFi

product.name: Custody
product.description: Institutional self-custody solution with zero counterparty risk, featuring MPC-powered transaction signing, fine-grained governance rules, and multi-TEE key protection.

product.name: Trade
product.description: Hybrid trading infrastructure offering high performance and fault tolerance with support for multi-chain, multi-asset, and multi-protocol trading.

product.name: Risk Management
product.description: Continuous risk monitoring and mitigation system to protect assets from price shocks and operational risks.

product.name: Web3 Treasury & Tokenization
product.description: Comprehensive solution for token issuance, vesting, distribution, and payments, with automated treasury operations and detailed reporting.

product.name: Build with PrimeVault
product.description: API and flexible deployment options for integrating PrimeVault's security and trading infrastructure into custom solutions.
